versions.changelog:
Initial release – provides end-to-end inventory demand planning expertise for multi-location retailers.

- Covers forecasting methods (moving averages, exponential smoothing, seasonal decomposition, regression, ML) with clear usage guidance.
- Includes best practices for forecast accuracy metrics (MAPE, WMAPE, bias, tracking signal).
- Details safety stock calculation, including adjustments for lead time variability and intermittent demand.
- Outlines reorder logic, with formulas and vendor frequency recommendations.
- Suitable for use cases ranging from promotional lift forecasting to inventory optimization and vendor negotiation.
